business_problem: Before the pandemic, the company had been steadily expanding its reach all over the world. But with offices in different countries, each with its own systems for managing customer data, Globus family of brands leadership lacked the visibility that's vital for growth and meaningful customer insights.
solution_summary: Globus family of brands had an outdated process for managing customer data, so it was nearly impossible to collect meaningful customer insights, and therefore nearly impossible to grow.
